[4] search_document: Cozy prop length ! Samuel Treffinger Hi, I was wondering what is the maximum prop length for a Cozy MK IV? This is assuming all standard construction, and leaving a propper amount of ground clearance. Thanks in advance, Sam ! Joe Hi On the insiude of the back cover of plans book 1 you can find all those measurements.. My prop was 72 which was 2 inches too long one gusty hard landing. Joe Toop ! Al Wick Hi Sam. I looked into this pretty thoroughly around a year ago. One of those topics that seems simple, yet has some hidden complexity. Risk vs reward. What's the benefit of longer prop? As I look into it, looks like the benefit is more myth than reality. Certainly not significant. What's the risk of long prop? It increases your odds of prop strike.....but there are all these little things you can do that also affect that risk. With the help of other fliers, I made a spreadsheet that measures features on your plane that affect odds of striking pavement. I was able to tweak my plane dimensions so that I'm lower risk than most Cozy's. You are welcome to the spreadsheet. I recommend 68" or shorter prop. Measure the things on the spreadsheet, just in case your plane a bit different. If you are at higher risk than most, then avoid rear cg high angle of attack landings. Thanks everyone for your data.
